title: ARCHITECTURE.md: normative infra/comms separation
description: Three-way model: infra operators (relay/SFU/TURN/KP store/push) policy-free; comms operators (Space owner/org) own identity, membership, policy, moderation, compliance, archive; RelayServiceAgreement is the only contract. Rule: a relay enforces nothing requiring knowledge of group membership. Relay-side bans -> Space-issued capability tokens. Compliance-hold Mechanisms A/B move space-side or dropped.
